tools.name: claix.schemas.list
tools.description: List the Claix schemas available for the authenticated account. Returns id, name, type, schema_definition, is_agent_mode, and agent_definition. Call this first whenever you need a schema_id before claix.extract.* or claix.agent.* tools.

tools.name: claix.schemas.get
tools.description: Get one Claix schema by schema_id (GET /api/get-schema/{schema_id}). Returns the full schema object (definition, Agent mode, Guardar Datos / window_context, source verification). Free call. 404 if missing or not owned by the API key.

tools.name: claix.schemas.create
tools.description: Create a Claix schema (POST /api/create-schema). Requires name, type (excel-json, json-excel, pdf-json, doc-json, img-json, txt-json, audio-json) and schema_definition. tools.name: claix.schemas.update
tools.description: Update a Claix schema (PUT /api/update-schema/{schema_id}). Same body as create: name, type, schema_definition; optional Agent mode, window_context (Guardar Datos), source verification. Replaces the full configuration. Free call.

tools.name: claix.schemas.delete
tools.description: Delete a Claix schema owned by the API key (POST /api/delete-schema). Requires schema_id.

tools.name: claix.markdown.excel
tools.description: Convert Excel/CSV to Markdown (POST /api/excel-markdown). No schema_id. Optional save=true inserts into the connected DB using Markdown rules and may return row_id; omit/false returns markdown only.

tools.name: claix.markdown.pdf
tools.description: Convert PDF to Markdown (POST /api/pdf-markdown). No schema_id. Optional save=true inserts into the connected DB using Markdown rules and may return row_id; omit/false returns markdown only.

tools.name: claix.markdown.doc
tools.description: Convert Word/text document to Markdown (POST /api/doc-markdown). No schema_id. Optional save=true inserts into the connected DB using Markdown rules and may return row_id; omit/false returns markdown only.

tools.name: claix.markdown.image
tools.description: Convert image to Markdown (POST /api/img-markdown). No schema_id. Optional save=true inserts into the connected DB using Markdown rules and may return row_id; omit/false returns markdown only.

tools.name: claix.markdown.text
tools.description: Convert plain text/HTML/XML to Markdown (POST /api/txt-markdown). content field, no file, no schema_id. Optional save=true inserts into the connected DB using Markdown rules and may return row_id; omit/false returns markdown only.

tools.name: claix.markdown.audio
tools.description: Convert spoken audio to Markdown (POST /api/audio-markdown). No schema_id. Optional save=true inserts into the connected DB using Markdown rules and may return row_id; omit/false returns markdown only.

tools.name: claix.multi_document.ask
tools.description: Ask up to 5 typed questions across up to 10 uploaded documents (POST /multi-document). Multipart: repeat field file for each document; questions as a JSON string of { question, format } (format: string|int|boolean|timestamp|array). Optional window_context, window_time, space_id match OpenAPI MultiDo

tools.name: claix.retrieve.ask
tools.description: Ask a Retrieve agent (POST /retrieve/{agent_name}). Controlled read against the live SQL database within the agent's routes. Body { questions: [{ question, format? }] }. format is required only for razonada agents; formats: string|int|boolean|timestamp|timestamptz|date|json|array:string|array:int. a

Returns allowed, needs_approval, verdict (allow | deny | needs_approval), reason, code, decision_id, violations. A write that do

tools.name: claix.routes.create
tools.description: Create a Retrieve route (POST /routes). Body: { name, description, rules, tables: [{ name, columns: string[] }] }.

tools.name: claix.routes.edit
tools.description: Edit a Retrieve route (PUT /routes/edit/{route_id}). Same body as create plus route_id path param.

tools.name: claix.routes.delete
tools.description: Delete a Retrieve route (POST /routes/delete/{route_id}). Requires route_id.

tools.name: claix.agents.create
tools.description: Create a Retrieve agent (POST /agents). Body: { name, slug, description, prompt, routes: uuid[], response_mode: "bruto"|"razonada", call_limit_period?: "day"|"week"|"month"|"unlimited", call_limit?: number }. Omit the limit fields for unlimited.

tools.name: claix.agents.edit
tools.description: Edit a Retrieve agent (PUT /agents/edit/{agent_id}). Same body as create plus agent_id. Omit call_limit_period and call_limit to keep the current cap.

tools.name: claix.agents.pause
tools.description: Pause or activate a Retrieve agent (POST /agents/pause/{agent_id}). Body: { status: "paused"|"active" }.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: claix.retrieve.ask, claix.guard.check, claix.routes.create, claix.routes.delete, claix.agents.create, claix.agents.pause · Private data: claix.schemas.get, claix.schemas.create, claix.schemas.delete, claix.extract.excel, claix.extract.doc, claix.extract.image, claix.extract.text, claix.convert.json_to_excel, claix.agent.doc, claix.agent.text, claix.markdown.excel, claix.markdown.pdf, claix.markdown.doc, claix.markdown.image, claix.markdown.text, claix.markdown.audio, claix.multi_document.ask, claix.retrieve.ask · Public sink: claix.schemas.create, claix.schemas.delete, claix.extract.text, claix.agent.text, claix.markdown.excel, claix.markdown.pdf, claix.markdown.doc, claix.markdown.image, claix.markdown.text, claix.markdown.audio, claix.multi_document.ask, claix.retrieve.ask, claix.guard.check, claix.routes.create, claix.routes.delete, claix.agents.create, claix.agents.pause · Destructive: claix.schemas.delete, claix.agent.excel, claix.agent.pdf, claix.agent.doc, claix.agent.image, claix.agent.text, claix.agent.audio, claix.multi_document.ask, claix.retrieve.ask, claix.routes.delete.

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
